Pee Dee (historical people)

The Pee Dee appear in historical accounts of the South Carolina Piedmont and coastal plain. The National Park Service includes the named historical people in its account of the region around Ninety Six.

Source & image record ↗ · Public domain · The National Map

This modern view shows the Great Pee Dee River in the Pee Dee region. The South Carolina directory entry refers to the historical people documented by the National Park Service and the Pee Dee Indian Tribe’s account of its history in this region. The image is resized for the web and retains the listed license.
